answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the wander is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
